coordinatorRefusal.message: Pi supports fresh file-tool workers with only the app's loopback gateway overlay

pi.fallback: Codex Lead + this harness as a roster worker, or owner-directed workers without a live Lead

coordinatorRefusal.message: Claude supports isolated file-tool workers with only the app loopback gateway overlay

claude-code.fallback: Codex Lead + this harness as a roster worker, or owner-directed workers without a live Lead

coordinatorRefusal.message: OpenCode accepts only file-worker profiles and an app loopback gateway overlay

opencode.fallback: Codex Lead + this harness as a roster worker, or owner-directed workers without a live Lead

limitations: Only Codex has a coordinator executor and enforced Lead tool policy in this application; other refusals do not prove a native harness cannot implement one
Native opt-in covers one Codex Lead turn and gateway policy denial, not live end-to-end delegation to the other harnesses
Codex-Lead fallbacks for Pi, Claude and OpenCode use real engine/gateway/Git with inert protocol fixtures in tests/lead-fallback.test.ts; separate live worker receipts are under M8 item 5
Personal-config evidence checks metadata of the listed files, not a complete isolation audit (M8 item 7)
